text.p: Zytec Corp said on Wednesday it withdrew a previously filed registration statement for a public offering of 2,272,000 common shares.
It also said third-quarter results, to be reported October 22, should be in line with analyst expectations, which average $0.16 per share.
The company said its continued cash flow and ample availability of bank credit lines provide enough financing for its near-term cash needs.
It will consider other potential long-term financing options as necessary.
Zytec is a designer and manufacturer of custom electronic power supplies for original equipment manufacturers in the communications, networking, computer and other electronic equipment marketplaces.
